source: ENISA Space Threat Landscape 2025, Annex C Table 17 (via Phalanx/framework/enisa_threats_tuple.csv)
name: Abuse/Falsification of rights
affected_asset_selectors: Ground: Design/dev/QA, Assembly, Manufacturing Systems, Misc (software), Misc (endpoint devices), Logistics Management System, Checkout systems, Mission Control System, Network (WAN)
description: Misuse or modification of access rights and permissions to IT systems may see adversaries gain access to these systems, after which they could be able to affect multitude of processes in any segment of the satellite lifecycle. The adversaries may affect those processes to collect information, change them or incapacitate them. This threat is frequently materialized via malicious insiders trading credentials for monetary rewards.

projection.lifecycle_rule: ET-P-LC-01 (legacy tuple L field; Annex C has no lifecycle column)

derivation_provenance.note: candidate_lifecycle copies the legacy tuple L field {3,4,5,6,7}; ENISA STL 2025 Annex C has no lifecycle column, so the basis is the legacy tuple, not the Annex
